2645-3181-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3899-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

728-3249-3621-4474.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3621-4474.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-7452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

225-3129-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-3129-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4359-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1453-2511--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

2464-4629-7124.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-4629-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6351-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3259-3263-4742-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-4742-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-4742-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1414-2051-4668-4970-5751.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in your hand.
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1414-2051-4668-4970-5751.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-3967-7211.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

1274-4050-4094-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4050-4094-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-3809-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2557-3809-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
2557-3809-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

11-1927-3258-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-3258-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Beacon of Tomorrows.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Beacon of Tomorrows spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Beacon of Tomorrows spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Beacon of Tomorrows and returning the original Beacon of Tomorrows to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Beacon of Tomorrows from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

874-1170-1329-2423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-2423.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Bounding Krasis.
When Bounding Krasis enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

6575-6685-6965.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1874-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1874-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

394-856-3967-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

575-3899-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-3899-4674.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

1737-4242-4853-5330.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

222-527-4359-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-4359-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-1987-4823.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
372-1987-4823.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

955-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
955-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2267-4798-5636-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2267-4798-5636-5686.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, putting a +1/+1 counter on Psychic Frog.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1246-4944-5299.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one Reflection on the battlefield.
1246-4944-5299.description:
Activate Spirit Mirror by paying {0}, targeting any Reflection.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Resolve all Spirit Mirror abilities, destroying the targeted Reflection(s).

539-1185-2577-4693.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Zombie.
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
539-1185-2577-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2034-4082-4763-4871.notablePrerequisites: Kemba has at least one Equipment attached.
2034-4082-4763-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kemba, adding {C}{C}.
Kemba dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Koll.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Kemba from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Kemba by paying {1}{W}.
Kemba enters the battlefield, attaching any Equipment you control to it.
Repeat.

950-1056-4684.notablePrerequisites:
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
You have at least one additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
950-1056-4684.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling cards from your graveyard equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Fatestitcher encore until end of turn.
Activate Fatestitcher's encore ability by paying {3}{U} and exiling it, causing you to create a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate a Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping a different Fatestitcher.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat from step 3.

1283-1309-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1283-1309-1987-3075.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1306-1368-3698.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mana Crypt, causing yourself to mill three cards.
Cast Mana Crypt from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2050-3620-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Gift of Paradise attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3620-4222.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Gift of Paradise, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.
